public_server.title: Make Server Public
public_server.info_desc: Your server will be accessible from the Internet using a secure tunnel.
public_server.experimental_warn: This feature is experimental and the address will change every time you restart.

services.pinggy_desc: Experimental. Quick tunnel via SSH. No installation needed.

playit.click_link: Click the link below to link this server to your Playit.gg account. Once authorized, the tunnel will connect automatically.

dashboard.force_stop_confirm: Server is not responding. Force close immediately? (Unsaved progress may be lost)

tunnel.about: Share your server with anyone on the internet. It gets a fixed address that stays the same even when the tunnel IP changes. DNS updates automatically.
tunnel.region_note: Region changes apply the next time you start the tunnel.
tunnel.dns_hint: DNS records used / zone limit (Cloudflare Free = 200)
tunnel.taken_pick: is already taken. Pick another name.
tunnel.verify_hint: Check that the custom address actually resolves
tunnel.clean_hint: Remove SRV records this app created but no longer uses
tunnel.playit_cta_desc: Free with playit.gg. Your friends keep the same address every time. One click, once.
tunnel.playit_waiting: Approve the link in your browser…
tunnel.playit_linked: playit.gg linked. Your next tunnel uses the permanent address.
tunnel.playit_unlink_confirm: Unlink playit.gg? Your permanent address stays in your playit account, but Cubi will use temporary Pinggy tunnels until you link again. Linking again creates a new agent: free accounts have an agent limit, so delete the old one at playit.gg/account/agents.
tunnel.playit_over_limit: Your free playit.gg account has too many agents (one is added every time you link). Delete the old ones at {url}. For now you get a temporary address.

share.starting_desc: The first start takes a bit longer while the world is generated.
share.connecting_desc: In a few seconds you'll have an address to share with your friends.
share.private_title: Your server is on, but only you can join
share.private_desc: Make it public to get an address your friends can join from anywhere.
share.ready_title: Share this address with your friends
share.how_to: In Minecraft: Multiplayer → Add Server → paste the address.
share.temporary: Temporary address: it changes every time and expires after 60 minutes.
share.upgrade: Get a permanent address for free
share.permanent: Permanent address: it stays the same every time you start the server.
share.time_limit: Free tunnel: it disconnects every 60 minutes and has to be restarted.

errors.mod_dependency: A mod is missing a dependency
errors.port_conflict: The port is already in use
errors.unknown_fix: Unknown error. Check the Console for details.
errors.bedrock_fix: Couldn't start the Bedrock tunnel. Check the Console for details.

bedrock.title: Crossplay with Bedrock
bedrock.floodgate_hint: Floodgate lets Bedrock players join without a Java account
bedrock.how_to: Bedrock players type the address and port in Play → Servers → Add Server.
bedrock.pinggy_note: Free tunnels expire after about 60 minutes; restart it to renew.
bedrock.local_port: Local UDP port: {port}. Let iOS, Android, Windows Bedrock and console players join.
bedrock.cta_title: Play with mobile and console friends
bedrock.cta_desc: Install GeyserMC from Plugins so iOS, Android, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and Windows Bedrock players can join.

library.title: Server Library
library.empty_desc: Create your first server and play with your friends in a minute.

settings.title: App Settings

auto_start.title: Auto-Start Last Server
auto_start.desc: Automatically boot the last active server on launch.

auto_update.title: Automatic Updates
auto_update.desc: Choose how the app handles new versions.

options.ask_desc: Check automatically, but download only when I confirm.

notifications.title: Desktop Notifications
notifications.desc: Alerts for server status and events.

appearance_settings.title: Appearance
appearance_settings.desc: Customize the look and feel of the application.
appearance_settings.reduce_effects_desc: Turns off background blur and film grain. Helps on older computers or when the app feels slow.

tray.title: Minimize to tray
tray.desc: Keep the app running in the system tray when you close the window.

dns.title: Fixed address
dns.desc: Give your server an address that never changes, even when the tunnel does.
dns.enable_desc: Your server gets an address like survival.play.ariser.app that updates itself every time the tunnel starts.
dns.url_placeholder: Leave empty to use the free community proxy
dns.url_hint: Advanced: only change this if you host your own proxy.
dns.info: When the tunnel starts, your server automatically gets a fixed address at [name].play.ariser.app. Free for everyone.

settings.about_tagline: Create a Minecraft server on your own PC and play with your friends in a minute. Free, no limits. Supports Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge.
settings.about_disclaimer: NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

advanced_props.title: Advanced server properties
advanced_props.subtitle: Edit the raw values in server.properties
advanced_props.warning: For advanced use. Wrong values can stop the server from starting.

props_desc.enforce_whitelist: Kick unlisted even if already on

raw_config.title: Raw Configuration
raw_config.desc: Access all raw properties stored securely in server.properties

system.java_path_desc: Explicit path or system environment variables.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Manage server operators, access, and bans.
players.empty: No players found in this list.
players.empty_online: Make sure the server is running.

worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.subtitle: Manage your worlds and backups.
worlds.restart_note: Switching the active world requires a server restart. Restoring a backup replaces the world folder and requires the server to be stopped.
worlds.restore_confirm:
Restore "{name}"?

The current world folder will be REPLACED. The server must be stopped.
worlds.delete_confirm: Delete backup "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
worlds.switch_confirm: Load "{world}"? The server must be restarted for this to take effect.

mods.unsupported_desc: You are using {type}. To install mods you need a modded server (Fabric / Forge / NeoForge).
mods.search_error: Failed to search mods. Please try again.
mods.no_versions: No compatible versions found for this server.
mods.deps_confirm:
{name} requires {count} mod(s). Dependencies must be installed separately.

Install anyway?

plugins.unsupported_desc: Plugins are only available for Paper, Spigot, or Bukkit servers.

wizard.title: New server
wizard.footer: Runs on your own PC. Free, no limits.

mode.title: What do you want to do?
mode.subtitle: You can have as many servers as you like.
mode.new_desc: We download and set up everything for you. Takes about a minute.
mode.import_desc: Add a server folder you already have on this PC.

type.title: How do you want to play?
type.subtitle: Not sure? Pick the recommended one: it works with any normal Minecraft.
type.vanilla: Plain Minecraft, exactly as Mojang made it.
type.paper: Like vanilla but faster, and supports plugins (minigames, protections, crossplay).
type.fabric: For light mods: performance, small tweaks.
type.forge: For big mods and classic modpacks.
type.mods_note: With mods, each friend needs the same mods installed in their game.
type.version_hint: Must match the version your friends play on.
type.loader_hint: Leave it as is if you're not sure.
type.versions_error: Couldn't load the versions. Check your internet connection.

details.title: Final details
details.subtitle: You can change all of this later.
details.name: Server name
details.ram_hint: More memory = more players and mods. Don't use more than half of your PC's RAM.
details.java_system: Java {v} needed. Your PC has Java {sys}; we'll get the right one.
details.java_unknown: Couldn't check Java. We'll try to set it up during the install.
details.eula_hint: Mojang's rules for running a server (aka.ms/MinecraftEULA).

import.title: Add an existing server
import.subtitle: Choose the folder that contains the server's .jar file.
import.invalid: That folder doesn't look like a Minecraft server. Choose the one with the .jar file.

install.title: Creating your server...
install.failed_hint: Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps failing, try another version.

app.saving_world: Saving the world and closing safely...
app.starting_slow: Taking a bit longer than usual. Hang on...

inventory.empty_desc: Inventories appear here once someone has joined this world.
inventory.assets_title: Show items with their real look
inventory.assets_desc: Cubi downloads the official game graphics from Mojang (about 25 MB, only once for all your servers) and draws the icons on your PC. Modded items use the mods you already have.
inventory.assets_auto: Getting the item graphics ready (about 25 MB from Mojang, only once for all your servers)...
